idea: An AI assistant that recommends internships to university students based on their CV and interests, explains why each one fits, and helps them tailor applications.
A tool for independent restaurants that reads supplier invoices, tracks ingredient price changes and tells the owner which menu items have become unprofitable.
A chatbot that tells people whether their symptoms need a doctor, urgent care or rest at home, without involving a clinician.
An app that lets friends lend each other small amounts of money with automatic repayment reminders and interest.
Uber for everything, powered by AI.
